<Route path='part/'>
  <Route path='category/:id?/*' element={<CategoryDetail />} />
  <Route path=':id/*' element={<PartDetail />} />
</Route>
<Route path='stock/'>
  <Route path='location/:id?/*' element={<LocationDetail />} />
  <Route path='item/:id/*' element={<StockDetail />} />
</Route>
<Route path='purchasing/'>
  <Route path='purchase-order/:id/*' element={<PurchaseOrderDetail />} />
  <Route path='supplier/:id/*' element={<SupplierDetail />} />
  <Route path='supplier-part/:id/*' element={<SupplierPartDetail />} />
  <Route path='manufacturer/:id/*' element={<ManufacturerDetail />} />
  <Route
    path='manufacturer-part/:id/*'
    element={<ManufacturerPartDetail />}
  />
</Route>
<Route path='company/:id/*' element={<CompanyDetail />} />
canonical_route part=part/:id/*
canonical_route part_category=part/category/:id?/*
canonical_route company=company/:id/*
canonical_route supplier=purchasing/supplier/:id/*
canonical_route manufacturer=purchasing/manufacturer/:id/*
canonical_route supplier_part=purchasing/supplier-part/:id/*
canonical_route manufacturer_part=purchasing/manufacturer-part/:id/*
canonical_route stock_location=stock/location/:id?/*
canonical_route stock_item=stock/item/:id/*
canonical_route purchase_order=purchasing/purchase-order/:id/*
